stock.description: Silk Road Energy Services Group Limited functions as an investment holding entity, providing a range of coal mining and construction solutions across the People's Republic of China. Its operations are divided into three core divisions: Coal Mining and Construction Services, Money Lending, and Heating Supply Services. The company is involved in various excavation and construction endeavors, delivers coal production services, and also extends its offerings to include money lending and heating supply. The firm adopted the name Silk Road Energy Services Group Limited in August 2015, having previously operated as China Natural Investment Company Limited. Its corporate headquarters are located in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
